description: Overview of the drill site
caption: Credit: IceCube/NSF Known as the tower operation site, the drill tower and reels move with each successive hole. There are two tower operation structures to allow continuous drilling. Seen here is the seasonal equipment site, tower, and hose reel.

description: IceCube South Pole team for the 2007-2008 season
caption: Credit: IceCube/NSF Known as the tower operation site, the drill tower and hose reels moved as each hole was completed. There were two towers, which allowed for continuous drilling.  Here, the drilling team from the 2007–2008 season poses on the tower in front of the South Pole station.
credit: IceCube Collaboration / NSF; see source caption
